description: An unusual 70 m² Parisian loft in the heart of the 11th arrondissement, a stone's throw from Bastille. Exposed stone walls, a glass roof and a large skylight give the place a unique charm. You will enjoy a spacious living room with a sofa bed, a fully equipped kitchen and a large bedroom with flexible sleeping arrangements. Located on the ground floor overlooking the courtyard, the property is ideal for exploring Paris as a couple, with family or with friends.
